verdict.rationale: MX documents a dedicated test platform with four test institutions and a downloadable OpenAPI spec importable into Postman, and separately documents OAuth testing behavior in the Connect Widget, supporting end-to-end linking/testing before production. However, the evidence doesn't show documented test credentials per institution, explicit coverage of simulating error states, or examples of retrieving test transaction/account data end-to-end. Missing for 10: documented test credentials, explicit error-state simulation guidance, and a walkthrough tying test institutions to data retrieval and error handling.
